name: @shing.wong/sure-store
description: Engine-agnostic storage contract: dialect tables, escape vocabulary and a verification suite shared by sure-mail, sure-factor, memeng and pai-core.
author: ShingWong

scripts.check:contracts: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');let n=0;for(const d of ['contracts','verification/fixtures'])for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d).filter(x=>x.endsWith('.json'))){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(d,f),'utf8'));n++}console.log(n+' JSON files valid')"
scripts.ci: npm run security:check && npm run check:contracts && npm test && npm run verify
